name: Sci-Fi Sitcom Toon
description: A retro-future animated sitcom: thick constant-width ink lines, a boiling 12 fps line, a dollhouse apartment on a tiny asteroid, a proud robot and a deadpan human, one gadget that glows, and silence as the punchline. For product gags, launches told as a joke, team culture.

inputs.label: Dil
inputs.help: Upper case follows it (Turkish i → İ; English i → I)

inputs.label: Başlık
inputs.help: The big starburst title; up to 5 letters keeps it full size

inputs.label: Kadran 4 (espri)
inputs.help: The setting the robot turns to; it sets up the punchline

inputs.label: Anlatıcı
inputs.default: Yıl 3025. Robot ev arkadaşınız kahvaltıyı hazırlıyor...
inputs.help: Spell numbers out for the voice; captions keep the digits

beats.label: The 60s space-age title pops on three beats over the apartment
Establishing two-shot: proud robot at the counter, deadpan roommate at the table
Insert: the robot's mitt turns the toaster dial past every setting to the last one
beats.sfx: toaster dial clicks, lever down, rumble

beats.label: Launch on the downbeat: the toast blasts through the ceiling hatch; crane up to orbit
beats.sfx: cartoon rocket launch, metal hatch clang

beats.label: Hard music cut: dead-silent deadpan close-up of the roommate
A beat later, the punchline; the toast drifts past the window
The band and the laugh track come back for the button

voice.direction: A warm sitcom narrator for the setup, and a second, brighter voice with a light metallic treatment for the robot. Strip eleven_v3 tags like [excited] from the word timings before captions.

music.prompt: upbeat retro-future 60s sitcom theme, theremin melody, bouncy upright bass, vibraphone, brushed drums, 130 BPM, with a clean stop, instrumental, no vocals

credits.name: lemo-opuscar Sci-Fi Sitcom Toon engine (toon.js, chars.js)
